run_update_data: run the script to update dataset files by transforming repeat actions into remove_condition filters
run_post_processing: run the post-processing script on a folder of Droidlet dataset files to add filter schematics
update_repeat_actions: update DANCE and MOVE actions with repeat counts by converting them to COMPARATOR remove_condition filters
transform_dataset_files: transform templated dataset files by replacing repeat keys with remove_condition for HUMAN_GIVE_COMMAND dialogue types
verify_updates: verify the number of updates applied to output files after post-processing the dataset folder
